{"title":"Withings","description":"Withings smart-scale body composition (weight, fat %, lean/fat mass, BMI, pulse).","defaults":{"dataSources":{"ds.search":{"options":{"queryParameters":{"latest":"$global_time.latest$","earliest":"$global_time.earliest$"}}}},"visualizations":{"global":{"showProgressBar":true}}},"inputs":{"input_global_trp":{"type":"input.timerange","options":{"token":"global_time","defaultValue":"-30d@d,now"},"title":"Time Range"},"input_person":{"type":"input.dropdown","title":"Person (temp)","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_person_list"},"options":{"token":"person","selectFirstSearchResult":true},"encoding":{"value":"primary.person_id","label":"primary.person_name"}},"input_units":{"type":"input.dropdown","title":"Units","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_units_opts"},"options":{"token":"units","selectFirstSearchResult":true},"encoding":{"value":"primary.units","label":"primary.units"}}},"dataSources":{"ds_person_list":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"| tstats count where `widx` by person_id
| lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT person_name splunk_user
| eval person_name=coalesce(person_name, person_id)
| eval is_self=if(splunk_user=="$env:user$",0,1)
| sort is_self person_name
| table person_id person_name"},"name":"People"},"ds_units_opts":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"| tstats count where `widx` by person_id
| head 1
| lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT units as pref
| eval pref=coalesce(pref,"metric")
| eval other=if(pref=="imperial","metric","imperial")
| eval units=mvappend(pref,other)
| mvexpand units
| table units"},"name":"Units"},"ds_weight":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=withings:body person_id="$person$"
| where isnum(weight_kg)
| stats latest(weight_kg) as k
| eval v=round(k*if("$units$"=="imperial",2.20462,1),1)
| table v"},"name":"Weight (kg/lb)"},"ds_bodyfat":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=withings:body person_id="$person$"
| where isnum(body_fat_pct)
| stats latest(body_fat_pct) as v
| eval v=round(v,1)
| table v"},"name":"Body fat"},"ds_lean":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=withings:body person_id="$person$"
| where isnum(lean_mass_kg)
| stats latest(lean_mass_kg) as k
| eval v=round(k*if("$units$"=="imperial",2.20462,1),1)
| table v"},"name":"Lean mass (kg/lb)"},"ds_fat":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=withings:body person_id="$person$"
| where isnum(fat_mass_kg)
| stats latest(fat_mass_kg) as k
| eval v=round(k*if("$units$"=="imperial",2.20462,1),1)
| table v"},"name":"Fat mass (kg/lb)"},"ds_bmi":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=withings:body person_id="$person$"
| where isnum(weight_kg)
| sort -_time
| head 1
| lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT height_cm
| eval v=round(weight_kg/((height_cm/100)*(height_cm/100)),1)
| table v"},"name":"BMI (computed)"},"ds_pulse":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=withings:body person_id="$person$"

| stats latest(heart_pulse) as v
| eval v=round(v,0)
| table v"},"name":"Pulse at weigh-in"},"ds_weight_trend":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=withings:body person_id="$person$"
| where isnum(weight_kg)
| sort _time
| eval Weight=round(weight_kg*if("$units$"=="imperial",2.20462,1),2)
| table _time Weight"},"name":"Weight trend (kg/lb)"},"ds_bodyfat_trend":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=withings:body person_id="$person$"
| where isnum(body_fat_pct)
| sort _time
| rename body_fat_pct as "Body fat %"
| table _time "Body fat %""},"name":"Body-fat % trend"},"ds_comp_trend":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=withings:body person_id="$person$"
| where isnum(fat_mass_kg)
| sort _time
| eval "Fat mass"=round(fat_mass_kg*if("$units$"=="imperial",2.20462,1),1), "Lean mass"=round(lean_mass_kg*if("$units$"=="imperial",2.20462,1),1)
| table _time "Fat mass" "Lean mass""},"name":"Body composition — fat vs lean (kg/lb)"},"ds_pulse_trend":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` sourcetype=withings:body person_id="$person$"
| where isnum(heart_pulse)
| sort _time
| rename heart_pulse as "Pulse (bpm)"
| table _time "Pulse (bpm)""},"name":"Pulse at weigh-in trend (bpm)"}},"visualizations":{"intro_md":{"type":"splunk.markdown","options":{"backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","markdown":"# Withings — body composition

at weigh-in trend (bpm)","hideWhenNoData":true},"glossary_md":{"type":"splunk.markdown","options":{"backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","markdown":"### About these metrics
- **Weight** — total body weight from the scale. **Neutral** — goal-dependent; the *trend* matters more than any single reading.
- **Body fat %** — proportion of your weight that is fat, via bioimpedance. **↓ lower is generally better** within a healthy range (too low is also unhealthy).
- **Fat mass** — body fat by mass (weight × fat %). **↓ lower is generally better** in a healthy range.
- **Lean mass** (fat-free mass) — everything that isn't fat: muscle, bone, water, organs. **↑ higher is generally better** — preserving lean mass is a good sign, especially while losing weight.
- **BMI** — weight ÷ height² (computed from your registry height). **Context** — a rough screen; ~18.5–24.9 is the typical 'normal' band, but it ignores muscle vs fat.
- **Pulse at weigh-in** — heart rate the scale measured while you stood on it (bpm). **↓ lower is generally better** as a loose fitness proxy — but it's a standing spot reading, not true resting HR.

_Weight/mass follow the **Units** toggle (kg or lb); the number is unit-free and the unit is shown in each panel title. Bioimpedance body-fat is an estimate — consistency (same scale, same time of day) makes the trend more reliable than absolutes. Muscle/bone/water breakdown isn't ingested yet._

**Learn more:** [Withings — Body composition](https://www.withings.com/us/en/body-composition)"}}},"layout":{"type":"absolute","options":{"width":1440,"height":1340,"display":"auto","backgroundImage":{"x":0,"y":0,"src":"/static/app/wearables/bg_health.svg","sizeType":"cover"}},"structure":[{"item":"intro_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":20,"w":1400,"h":120}},{"item":"weight_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":160,"w":226,"h":150}},{"item":"bodyfat_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":256,"y":160,"w":226,"h":150}},{"item":"lean_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":492,"y":160,"w":226,"h":150}},{"item":"fat_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":728,"y":160,"w":226,"h":150}},{"item":"bmi_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":964,"y":160,"w":226,"h":150}},{"item":"pulse_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":1200,"y":160,"w":220,"h":150}},{"item":"weight_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":330,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"bodyfat_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":330,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"comp_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":650,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"pulse_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":650,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"glossary_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":970,"w":1400,"h":340}}],"globalInputs":["input_global_trp","input_person","input_units"]}}
